paragraphs.text: The Drannith Defense Force , informally called the Coppercoats for their banded uniforms and polished buttons, were the most well-resourced, powerful military force on Ikoria .

Drannith 's survival strategy was strength; they faced monstrous threats head-on, beating them back from within their walls. The Coppercoats were a tight-knit militia of city defenders, uniformed defense mages , and magistrates. Soldiers used pikes, ballistae, nets, and other anti-monster weaponry to keep monsters at bay, while the mages of the Arcane Corps engaged monsters directly with attack spells and defensive enchantments and helped maintain the crystal alarm system that warns of incoming monsters. People joined the Coppercoats from a very young age, as even children donned uniforms and fought alongside adults. The General of the Coppercoats served as the city's leader.
